verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents Auth0 FGA, a relationship-based fine-grained authorization system explicitly positioned beyond RBAC for multi-tenant B2B APIs/apps and RAG document-level access control, alongside standard RBAC roles/permissions and scopes for coarser control. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of FGA in production use, deeper docs on policy modeling (e.g. Zanzibar-style relationship tuples) within this pack, and community corroboration of FGA's real-world fit.
